fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-09-08 at approximately 00:55, it was reported that a silver motorcycle bearing registration number TN-39-YY-1043 was found missing from the parking space near Kalai Colony Apartment Complex. The complaint was lodged by Chandran Krishnan (9000000031). No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Amudha Kannan (9000000066) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint refers to Ajith Murugan, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000225. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
